regressions.title: Capture export polish can now remove the only surviving copy of a claim
regressions.evidence: The new placed_text coverage suppresses verification blockquotes for claims present in step narration. Export polish can still rewrite capture narration; its preservation guard applies only to photo mode. The final coverage check examines narrative alone and restores only the original narrative, which now may also omit those claims. A read-only probe with source 'Open the console and save the settings.' produced verify IDs [], accepted narration rewrite 'Open the console.' with gate result (True, None), and final coverage (False, ['claim-001']). Before this delta, the missing narrative claim received a preserved verification blockquote.
